values.note: No dogs, no mopeds, no campfires. Ice and LP gas sold; pavilion. Bring your own hotspot (the park says Verizon has the best coverage).

values.note: Call (239-472-1433) or email to check availability first, then submit the online reservation form and pay by check or card. Arrivals after 8 p.m. park in the slots before the gate. Cancellation needs a week's notice ($2 charge).

summary: Confirmed on the operator's site: $65 off season / $70 in season a night, full hookups (amperage not stated), showers/laundry, no Wi-Fi, no dogs, no campfires, reserved by phone/email then form. Amperage, site count, max length and season not stated. Note (--AWH) kept. Flags: over the price line with no gateway, and a mixed residential/lot-sale park.
flags: Price gate: base $65-70 a night (operator, rates undated on the live 2026 page) is over US$50; gateways.py finds nothing within 40 km (nearest Everglades NP 93 km). Only matters if the family has not stayed here.

Long-stay/residential check: the park also sells lots ('Lots for Sale' page lists ~10 RV/park-model lots at $45,000-$100,000) and has 'Permanent Residences $9,000 per year Park Models, $10,000 per year for Manufactured Homes'; its residents' rules say 'Adults only are permitted as Permanent Residents'. Nightly camping is still sold to transients ($70/night, tents to motorhomes), so it may pass the five-test rule - a human should decide.
Rate date: the rates section carries no year; the page is live in 2026 (uploads from 2026-08/09).
